answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE F1 scores against reference summaries; we also report BERTScore which computes the contextual similarity between a candidate and its reference summary. We evaluate FAME models on semantic inference metrics such as textual entailment (ent.) and question answering (Feqa). In addition, we train a scorer leveraging manually annotated document-summary pairs for faithfulness, called BERTFaithful.
